ryans.name: Ryan Leonard
ryans.title: Right wing for the Washington Capitals; 2023 first-round pick and former Boston College star
ryans.photo_credit: Sandro Halank, Wikimedia Commons (cropped and resized)
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Leonard** (born January 21, 2005) is an American professional ice hockey right winger for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL) [4]. The Capitals chose him eighth overall in the 2023 NHL Draft [1]. He played two seasons at Boston College, where he led the nation in goals as a sophomore and was named Hockey East Player of the Year [1][2]. He captained the United States to the 2025 World Junior Championship gold medal and was named the tournament's most valuable player [1].
known_for: Hockey East Player of the Year and nation's goals leader, 2024–25
Captain and MVP of the U.S. team at the 2025 World Juniors
45 points as a rookie for Washington, 2025–26

ryans.name: Ryan Craig
ryans.title: Head coach of the Vegas Golden Knights
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Craig** (born January 6, 1982) is a Canadian ice hockey coach and former centre who is head coach of the Vegas Golden Knights of the NHL [1][3]. He was named the franchise's fifth head coach on June 17, 2026, replacing John Tortorella [1][2]. He was an assistant on the Vegas staff that won the Stanley Cup in 2023 [1].
known_for: Fifth head coach of the Vegas Golden Knights
2016 Calder Cup as Lake Erie captain
